assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final production landing page hero photograph, very wide 16:7 composition, at least 2000 pixels wide.
Primary request: A physical architectural graph model on a saturated orange drafting surface. A web of matte white cubic modules and smooth white spherical junctions, joined by slim white rods, branching from left to right. Exactly one continuous selected route through the graph uses black rods and two black junctions. All other connectors and nodes are white.
Scene/backdrop: seamless orange #f25120 studio floor and back wall; fine, subtle pale orange drafting grid lines on the floor. No marks except the regular grid.
Style/medium: realistic photographic 3D clay architectural model with tactile white painted surfaces, realistic contact shadows and carefully made physical connections. Crisp editorial product photography.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:7 panorama, low three-quarter view looking slightly down across the graph; the complete model is comfortably inside the frame, with a little orange space around its edges. Around 12 cubic modules of modestly varied sizes and 8 spherical junctions, connected as a coherent layered branching graph from a larger cube at left through intermediate branches to terminal modules at right. The model spans most of the width. Orange scene fills every edge. Keep each node separated and legible.
Lighting/mood: soft directional studio daylight from upper left; nuanced shadows on orange, clean and precise, elegant engineering model.
Materials/textures: matte clay white cubes with lightly bevelled edges and subtle seams; white spheres; slim smooth white and black connecting rods.
Constraints: no text, no typography, no numbers, no labels, no captions, no annotations, no arrows, no UI, no panels, no logo, no watermark. No floating components, no impossible detached rods, no people. One single image only.
